comment: SHA-256 digests of the INSTALLED @vilnacrm/ui-toolkit build artifacts. The package is a GitHub release tarball, and bun records no sha512 for a remote-tarball dependency, so these digests are the only local evidence that the bytes behind the pinned URL are the bytes that were reviewed. `make lint-ui-toolkit` verifies them offline; refresh them only through `make update-ui-toolkit` after re-reviewing the release.
